answer: The juniper index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1886 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the lagoon. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the onyx queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. That is 11 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
